description: Transitive dependency closure for the @archie/runtime v2 release projection. Supplies the complete npm lock packages block used by npmProjectionV2 to generate a target-ready lock that includes every external dependency without network access.
createdBy: Generated from an empty temp directory: npm init -y, then add @archie/runtime production dependencies from the runtime package.json with their exact pinned versions, then npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts. Extract packages from the resulting package-lock.json and remove the root entry.
regenerationNotes: Run in a fresh temp directory with a package.json containing only the runtime production dependencies at their pinned versions, then copy the packages block (minus root) into this file. The check-package-content script verifies the file is packed; a stale template will cause npm ci integrity mismatches in target installations.
